title: How different the skipped CVEs are
subtitle: How well a logistic regression tells the CVEs the NVD analyzed from the ones it skipped, shadow window

plan.title: How different the skipped CVEs are
plan.population: CVEs published in the shadow window, held out half for scoring
plan.estimator: logistic regression domain classifier on filer, filer type, CWE, month, vector presence and description TF-IDF; AUC with interval; top features
plan.prediction: the classifier separates them well, so NVD labels alone would bias a model
plan.interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

population: CVEs published in the shadow window (from 2026-04-15), rejected excluded
window: shadow only; fitted on the earlier half by publication time, scored on the later half
interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

cves.population: CVEs published in the shadow window (from 2026-04-15), rejected excluded

analyzed_fit.population: CVEs in the fit half the NVD analyzed

analyzed_score.population: CVEs in the score half the NVD analyzed

auc.population: CVEs in the later half of the shadow window

features.population: features the classifier was fitted on

halves.population: the two halves of the shadow window, split by publication time

features_toward_analyzed.population: the fifteen features that most raise the odds the NVD analyzed a CVE

features_toward_skipped.population: the fifteen features that most lower the odds the NVD analyzed a CVE

prediction_check: AUC 0.886 on the later half (95 percent interval 0.827 to 0.928); the groups separate well, so NVD labels alone would bias a model toward the CVEs the NVD chose.
method: A logistic regression (liblinear, C = 1) on one hot filer and filer type (a filer seen fewer than three times is pooled), the filer's CWE ids, the published month as months since April 2026, whether the filer gave a CVSS 3.x and a CVSS 4.0 vector, and a TF-IDF of the description (words and word pairs seen at least five times, at most 30,000). The label is whether the NVD analyzed the CVE by the cut. The AUC is computed on the later half only, with a cluster bootstrap by filer over that half, 2,000 resamples, 95 percent. The later half has had less time to be analyzed, which the month feature carries; the AUC measures how separable the groups are, not a model to apply.
sql:
-- Q8: the shadow window, the registered features and the label, split by time into the half
-- the classifier is fitted on and the half it is scored on.
select
    half,
    count(*) as cves,
    avg(cast(nvd_analyzed as integer)) as share_analyzed,
    min(published) as first_published,
    max(published) as last_published
from gold.mart_domain_shift
group by half
order by min(position)

departure.reason: Rejected CVEs are left out of the population: the NVD never analyzes a rejected CVE, so keeping them would measure rejection, not the NVD's choice of what to analyze.
